title: Apartment 410, Block J, Castleforbes Square, IFSC, Dublin 1
seoTitle: Apartment 410, Block J, Castleforbes Square, IFSC, Dublin 1
description:
Beautiful apartment to rent in the IFSC/Docklands area.

Close to Google/Salesforce/Facebook offices, City Centre, Grand Canal Dock, IFSC, Docklands, Ringsend Park, Dublin Convention Centre, Connolly train station, and Busaras bus station. 30 seconds walk from "The Point" Luas stop.
Fully-furnished, in excellent condition. 
Beautiful balcony overlooking the Three Arena and The Point Luas stop. Access to 8th floor roof-garden with wonderful views of the city and the Dublin mountains.
30 seconds walk from local shops, restaurants, coffee shops, Odeon cinema, Luas, and much more.

Furniture includes: large L-shaped white leather couch, dining table with 4 chairs, large book-case in the living room, coffee-table, balcony furniture, Queen-sized bed, large wardrobes, dishwasher, microwave, fridge/freezer, washing machine/dryer, and a full-sized bath.
Very quiet and safe neighbourhood, close to beautiful walks along the quays.
1 double bedroom, 1 bathroom with bath.

Strictly no pets, and no smoking.

One Electricity bill covers central heating and hot water, and one Virgin bill covers internet, TV and landline phone, if required.
Facilities include: Washing machine, Tumble Dryer, Dishwasher, Balcony, Heating, Wired for Internet and Cable TV, Microwave, Wheelchair access, Fully furnished.
